title: RenderSettings
description: Mirrors hayro::RenderSettings. This is documentation, kept in sync by hand with the RenderSettingsJson struct in src/lib.rs, not something validated against at runtime.

force_image_interpolation.description: true draws every image with bilinear interpolation, whatever the PDF asks for. Absent means "use hayro's default" (read from RenderSettings::default() at call time, not hardcoded here).
